name: case-study-page
title: Case study page
description: A case study template from library items: the client's name with its live link, then the work in masonry columns.
use_for: A case study whose work carries the argument. Edit lib/pages/case-study.ts or pass `content`; `sections` reorders or leaves sections out.
never: New colors, shadows, radii or type sizes added to a section: use the items' props
People, clients or quotes you have no right to show: the defaults are Acme
A second plate button in a view
source: Built from the library's site items, after the site's components/case-wall.tsx, app/work/[slug]/page.tsx.

files.content:
import { footer, header } from '@/lib/pages/chrome'
// The case study page template's copy (components/case-wall.tsx): the client's name, its live link and the work.
export const caseStudyContent = {
	header,
	title: 'Acme',
	link: { label: 'Visit Acme', href: '#' },
	pieces: [
		{ src: '', ratio: 4 / 3 },
		{ src: '', ratio: 3 / 4 },
		{ src: '', ratio: 1, caption: 'Onboarding flow, in progress' },
		{ src: '', ratio: 16 / 9 },
		{ src: '', ratio: 4 / 5 },
		{ src: '', ratio: 4 / 3 },
	],
	footer,
}
export type CaseStudyContent = typeof caseStudyContent
export const caseStudySections = ['wall'] as const
export type CaseStudySection = (typeof caseStudySections)[number]
